newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Christopher says situation still dangerous.
newsitem.headline: Christopher says situation still dangerous.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher said on Sunday after meeting Palestinian President Yasser Arafat the situation between Israel and the PLO was still dangerous although tensions had eased.
"The situation has eased somewhat...but it is still a dangerous situation," Christopher told reporters.
Christopher met Arafat in the Gaza Strip after talks in Jerusalem with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Israel and the PLO resume U.S.-brokered peace talks in Gaza later in the day.
"Chairman Arafat told me he was doing everything he could to ensure that calm would remain," Christopher said in Gaza.
The secretary of state urged Israel and the PLO to achieve concrete results quickly in their talks to prevent a resurgence of violence that kill 58 Palestinians and 15 Israeli soldiers.
"I think it's essential that both parties in the negotiations emerge as winners, otherwise both will be losers," Christopher said.
